newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemeni President receives Saudi Interior Minsiter Prince Nayef, review ways of boosting relations.
- Activity at Saudi Arabia's Dammam port increases 38 percent last month.
- Saudi Industrial Development Fund agrees to extend 326 million riyals to finance six industrial projects.
- South Africa seeks to increase economic cooperation with Saudi Arabia.
- Senior Saudi Arabian and South African officials to hold talks this month on setting up a joint economic commission.
- Gulf Arab industry ministers to hold meeting next month in Riyadh.
